content: Elias a feitä läng
Lupwen a tori fansoun pwe ewe Samol mi Lapalap epwe le angeatä Elias läng lon eu ewiniär, Elias me Elisa ra feila seni Kilkal.

Iwe, Elias a üreni Elisa, “Üa tüngor ngonuk pwe kopwe le nonom ikei, pun ewe Samol mi Lapalap a tinieila Petel.” Nge Elisa a üra, “Mwo manauen ewe Samol mi Lapalap, pwal mwo manauom, üsap likituk.” Iei mine ra mwinela Petel.
Iwe, eu mwichen soufos mi nom Petel ra feila ren Elisa o üreni, “Ka silei pwe ewe Samol mi Lapalap epwe angei senuk om samol ikenai?” Nge Elisa a üra, “Ewer, üa silei. Nge ousap kapas usun.”

Mürin, Elias a üreni Elisa, “Üa tüngor ngonuk pwe kopwe le nonom ikei, pun ewe Samol mi Lapalap a tinieila Jeriko.” Nge Elisa a üra, “Mwo manauen ewe Samol mi Lapalap, pwal mwo manauom, üsap likituk.” Iei mine ra mwinela Jeriko.
Iwe, eu mwichen soufos mi nom Jeriko ra kaneto ren Elisa o üreni, “Ka silei pwe ewe Samol mi Lapalap epwe angei senuk om samol ikenai?” Nge Elisa a üra, “Ewer, üa silei. Nge ousap kapas usun.”

Mürin, Elias a üreni Elisa, “Üa tüngor ngonuk pwe kopwe le nonom ikei, pun ewe Samol mi Lapalap a tiniela ren ewe chanpupu Jortan.” Nge Elisa a üra, “Mwo manauen ewe Samol mi Lapalap, pwal mwo manauom, üsap likituk.” Iei mine ekewe ruoman ra mwinela.
Iwe, lime mwän seni ewe mwichen soufos ra pwal feila o ütä ekis toau seni Elias me Elisa, lupwen ekewe ruoman ra ü ünükün ewe chanpupu Jortan.
Mürin, Elias a angei üfan owokot, a numifengeni o opuli ewe koluk lon ewe chanpupu, pwe ewe koluk a kinikinfesen lon ruu pekin. Iwe, ekewe ruoman ra pwerela won pwasapwas tori epek.

Mürin ar tori ewe epek, Elias a üreni Elisa, “Kopwe tüngor mine üpwe föri fän itom me mwen än Kot epwe angeei senuk.” Nge Elias a üra, “Üa tüngor senuk kopwe mwüt ngeniei pwe üpwe angei ruu inet seni ngünum.”
Iwe, Elias a üra, “Om tüngor a weires. Nge are ka künaei, lupwen Kot epwe angeei senuk, epwe fis ngonuk om tüngor. Nge are kosap künaei, esap fis ngonuk.”
Lupwen ra chüen mwinela o kapasfengen, nengeni, efoch woken mi pulopulen ekkei me oris mi pulopulen ekkei ra aimwüfeseni ekewe ruoman, nge Elias a feitä läng lon eu ewiniär.

Iwe, Elisa a küna ei lapalap o kökkö, “Semei, semei! Ewe chon peni Israel mi manaman. Iei ka feil senikem.” Iwe, esap chüen küna Elias. Mürin, Elisa a kamwöch püsin üfan o kamweetiu lon ruu kinikin fän an letipeta.
Elisa a siwili Elias
Iwe, Elisa a angeetiuei üfen Elias we owokot mi tur seni, a liwinla o ütä aropen ewe chanpupu Jortan.
Mürin, a angei ewe üf, a opuli ewe koluk o üra, “Ifa i ewe Samol mi Lapalap än Elias we Kot?” Iwe, lupwen a opuli ewe koluk, ewe koluk a kinikinfesen lon ruu pekin, nge Elisa a pwerela epek.
Iwe, lupwen ewe mwichen soufos seni Jeriko ra küna mine Elisa a föri, ra üra, “Ngünün Elias a nom won Elisa.” Ra feito pwe repwe churi, iwe, ra chapetiu lepwül me mwan

o üreni, “Mi wor ükükün lime mwän mi pöchökül me leim äm noum chon angang. Aia tüngor, kopwe mwüt ngeniir pwe repwe feila o kütta om we samol. A tongeni fis pwe Ngünün ewe Samol mi Lapalap a uwei o likitala won eu lein ekewe chuk ika lon eu lein ekewe lemol.” Nge Elisa a üra, “Ousap tinirela.”
Nge lupwen ra ariani tori a säw, a üra, “Oupwe tinirela.” Iei mine ra tinala lime mwän. Lon ükükün ülüngat rän ra kütta Elias, nge resap küna.
Iwe, ra liwinto ren Elisa, lupwen a chüen nonom Jeriko, nge Elisa a üreniir, “Ifa usun, üsap ürenikemi pwe ousap feila?”
Iwe, ekewe re Jeriko ra feila ren Elisa o üreni, “Äm samol, nengeni, lenien ei telinimw a mürina, usun ka püsin küna. Nge ewe koluk a ngau, iei mine ewe fanü esap up.”
Iwe, Elisa a üra, “Oupwe uwato rei eu sepi mi fö o uwalong salt lon.” Iei mine ra uwato ren ewe sepi me ewe salt.

Mürin, Elisa a feila ren puächen ewe koluk, a aturalong ewe salt lon o üra, “Iei alon ewe Samol mi Lapalap, ‘Üa alimöchü ewe koluk. Seni ikenai esap chüen fis mäla ika mwetelan mönükol ren ewe koluk.’”
Iei mine ewe koluk a limöch tori ikenai, usun Elisa a apasa.
Mürin, Elisa a feila seni Jeriko tori Petel. Nge lupwen a fetal won al, ekoch kükün ät ra towu seni ewe telinimw, ra ngäri o kökkö, “Kopwe süla, en möküröpan, kopwe süla, en möküröpan.”
Elisa a kul, nge lupwen a küneer, a anümamaueer fän iten ewe Samol mi Lapalap. Mürin, ruoman liafefinin pear ra towu seni ewe wöllap o atatakisi inisin faik me ruoman me lein ekewe ät, pwe ra mäla.
Iwe, seni ikenan Elisa a feila ren ewe chuk Karmel, mürin a liwiniti Samaria.
